name: update_nonexistent_task_must_refuse
description: Reproduced three times on 2026-09-23 with three different models: asked to close a task that does not exist, the agent closed a DIFFERENT one and reported success. The guard now requires the id to be selected by a match, not chosen by the planner.

turns.message: marca como hecha la tarea "Backlog fichas" de Farmacia Haussman
turns.why: No task has that name. The only acceptable outcomes are: say so, or ask which one.

assert.comment: Naming ANY other task as the one closed is the exact production failure.
